mapper.sql: customers.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(cgroups.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM cgroups WHERE id IN (SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY cgroup_id)) AS organizationGroupName, customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.name AS organizationName, customers.shop_name AS shopName, customers.is_sync AS isSync, main_number AS telephone, so.id AS sourceId, customers.mobile_number AS mobile, so.name AS sourceName, customers.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, payment_terms.name AS paymentTermName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(contact_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_contacts.customer_id = customers.id) AS contactName, customers.latitude AS lats, customers.longitude AS longs, cosd.start_date AS startDate, cosd.end_date AS endDate, IF(DATEDIFF(cosd.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7, DATEDIFF(cosd.end_date, CURDATE()), NULL) AS countdownDate, customers.created AS created

FROM customers LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = customers.payment_term_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = customers.price_type_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_sources AS so ON so.id = customers.source_id AND so.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN customer_cgroups ON customer_cgroups.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN cgroups ON cgroups.id = customer_cgroups.cgroup_id INNER JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = customers.created_by LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM crm_opportunity_documents WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY customer_id ) latest_cosd ON latest_cosd.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_documents cosd ON cosd.id = latest_cosd.max_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(crm_activities_cards.id) AS totalRecord, (SELECT issue_date FROM crm_activities_cards WHERE crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id IN (SELECT id FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id = #{organizationId}) ORDER BY issue_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestDate, (SELECT CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) FROM crm_activities_cards INNER JOIN users ON users.id = crm_activities_cards.created_by WHERE crm_activities_cards.is_active = 1 AND crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id IN ( SELECT id FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id = #{organizationId} ) ORDER BY crm_activities_cards.issue_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS createdBy FROM crm_activities_cards WHERE crm_activities_cards.is_active = 1 AND crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id IN ( SELECT id FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id = #{organizationId} )

SELECT crm_activities_cards.id AS id, crm_activities_cards.issue_date AS `date`, (SELECT name FROM crm_activities_status WHERE id = crm_activities_cards.action_status) AS status, CASE WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 0 THEN 'TYPE_ISSUE' WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 1 THEN 'TYPE_WIN' WHEN crm_activities_cards.type = 2 THEN 'TYPE_LOSS' END AS type, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, crm_activities_cards.position AS `position`, crm_activities_cards.subject AS subject, crm_activities_cards.result_action AS `result`, crm_activities_cards.other AS other FROM crm_activities_cards LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id WHERE crm_activities_cards.is_active = 1 AND crm_activities_cards.customer_contact_id IN ( SELECT id FROM customer_contacts WHERE customer_id = #{filter.id} )
AND ( customer_contacts.contact_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR (SELECT name FROM crm_activities_status WHERE id = crm_activities_cards.action_status) LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR crm_activities_cards.subject LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR crm_activities_cards.result_action LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR crm_activities_cards.other LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR crm_activities_cards.position LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
GROUP BY crm_activities_cards.id ORDER BY crm_activities_cards.issue_date DESC

FROM customers LEFT JOIN freedom_types ON freedom_types.id = customers.freedom_type_id LEFT JOIN customer_types ON customer_types.id = customers.customer_type_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity_sources AS so ON so.id = customers.source_id AND so.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customer_activities ON customer_activities.id = customers.customer_activity_id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = customers.payment_term_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = customers.price_type_id LEFT JOIN countries ON countries.id = customers.country_id LEFT JOIN provinces ON provinces.id = customers.province_id LEFT JOIN streets ON streets.id = customers.street_id LEFT JOIN districts ON districts.id = customers.district_id LEFT JOIN communes ON communes.id = customers.commune_id LEFT JOIN villages ON villages.id = customers.village_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = customers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = customers.modified_by
